answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the karst of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The timber is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the cedar. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, forfeited on duplicate submission. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
